notes: All 12 views inspected. Cab-over tractor with a two-deck lattice trailer carrying two small cars. The trailer is a separate object pivoted on the kingpin so it can articulate, its four wheels are parented to it, all eight wheels roll on their axles and the front pair also steer. Cab windows are translucent with seats, dashboard and steering wheel behind them. No brand or text anywhere.
limitations: Stylized, not photoreal: this is a Cozy-kit vehicle with a simplified pastel palette.
The two cargo cars are static and cannot be driven off the deck.
The loading ramps are fixed in the raised position.
method: Visual inspection of local-model renders and technical reports
